s41_depth.method: seed-equal bounded fractional-response regression of min(T,budget), with a quadratic predictor and logistic link; unconstrained curvature
s41_depth.x_transform: specified numeric positions; log2 for width, heads and nonzero supervision fraction
s41_depth.bootstrap_unit: training seed; resample complete seed blocks
s41_depth.note: Non-reaching runs enter only as observed min(T,budget); curve does not estimate their unobserved convergence time.
